question: Which reality star just barely dodged jail time?
story: A Real Housewives star just paid roughly two thousand five hundred dollars to keep herself out of jail. If you watched Real Housewives of Atlanta, you know Kim Zolciak. Her divorce from former NFL player Kroy Biermann has been dragging on for years, and it keeps getting messier. According to TMZ, a Georgia judge ordered Zolciak to hand over about two thousand five hundred dollars in outstanding court fees tied to the case, with a very real warning attached. Pay up, or face jail time. Reports say she cleared the entire balance on July fourteenth, just before the threat became real. This all sits on top of a tense custody battle over the couple's four children. Sources say the two have been trading accusations in court filings for months now. So she keeps her freedom, for now. But this divorce is somehow still nowhere near finished.
